added: Custom theme: pick exact colours with a full colour picker (saturation/brightness square, hue bar, and hex entry) for primary, secondary, and tertiary roles
Custom theme: light and dark background colours can now be set directly, with an Auto option that derives them from the primary colour
Custom theme: Light/Dark/Auto mode support; the mode row now controls the custom theme instead of switching away from it
changed: Custom theme previews and saved-theme swatches now show the exact colours the applied theme uses
Saved custom themes now restore their colours and light/dark mode faithfully, and tapping a saved theme row loads it
fixed: Custom themes were always rendered in light mode regardless of the selected mode
Switching Light/Dark/Auto while the custom theme was active silently switched to the Teal palette
